title: Serve until the complaint quiets
summary: Service ripens into Naam and quiets inner complaint. Gather the mind before you call it service.
takeaway: Gather the mind before you call it service.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Service ripens into Naam and quiets inner complaint.
source.lifeApplication: Before asking for more clarity, answer one need and stay with it.

evidence.coreClaim: Service ripens into Naam and quiets inner complaint.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: serve the Guru until complaint thins and love for the Beloved rises.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
